CU GRANT Act Funding
Dear Faculty/Staff, I hope this email finds you well during this challenging time. I am writing to let you know that the Cornell University Grant Act grant has been increased for you. This additional funding was provided by the U.S. Department of Education as a result of the GRANT Act. GRANT funding is intended and should be used for faculty/staff expenses related to the disruption of campus operations due to coronavirus, such as food, housing, materials, technology, health care and child-care expenses. The CU CARES Act grant has applied to your spring semester account and is in the process of being refunded directly to you. You can track the status of your refund in your WebLogic account (access CU portal > select the Costs and Aid tab > select Copay > select Faculty/Staff Choice Refunds). The refund will take approximately 2-3 business days to process. If you have any questions or concerns please let us know by emailing sfs@cornell.edu. Sincerely, Director, Financial Services Cornell University Financial Services FINAID@cornell.edu
